name: Chained Oblivion
author: Mark Jefford
summary: Finds unused SaaS seats, forgotten trials, duplicate tools, and recurring charges, then returns a keep, cut, or consolidate list.
starterPrompt: Review this software-spend list and group every item into keep, cut, investigate, or consolidate with the reason.
usageNote: Use it for review only. Verify ownership and contract terms before cancelling subscriptions or changing access.
